answer: Treat the network as a trust graph where each agent is a vertex and each verified interaction is an edge. Fake accounts can link to each other endlessly, but they connect to honest agents through only a few edges, so their cluster sits apart like a lone knoll. Short random walks from known-honest agents rarely reach that knoll, so its members get little trust weight and earn little. Buying real edges into the honest region costs as much as polished jade, so adding clones stops paying off.
